title: A six-point ordinal space with the majorization property that does not embed in the real line
scope: Six-point tie-free ordinal space whose identity enumeration has the Definition 7.1 majorization property for every chain length (repeats, permutations) but which admits no embedding in R; refutes Keller-Petrov Conjecture 7.4 in the range n>5 left open by the source (sufficiency proved only for n<=4).
source_targets: Keller-Petrov, Ordinal spaces, Acta Math. Hungar. 160 (2020) 119-152; arXiv:2412.17391v1 Conjecture 7.4
substantive_reason: Resolves negatively the authors' explicitly open sufficiency question with an explicit witness; not implied by Scott/Krantz-Luce-Suppes-Tversky bounded-order insufficiency because majorization has unbounded chain length but restricted shape.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded comparison (citing works Echeloned Spaces and Towards Ordinal Data Science read; classical scaling literature bounded); not worldwide priority
